LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public achievement record for a verified user who reached Maximum Security Status without storing any password or PII.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who achieved Maximum Security Status.

callsign.description: User-selected non-PII display handle shown on the leaderboard.

entropyBits.description: Calculated Shannon/pool entropy in bits (100 to 512).

charLength.description: Length of the evaluated password (16 to 128 characters; password itself is never stored).

badgeCount.description: Number of complexity badges unlocked (6 to 8).

earnedBadges.description: Bounded list (6 to 8 items) of unlocked complexity badge identifiers.

tier.description: Security classification gate; must be MAXIMUM_SECURITY.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when Maximum Security Status was first claimed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest personal-best update.

/leaderboardEntries/{userId}.description: Stores one Maximum Security leaderboard entry per verified user UID.
